compactRecord.rs: The actual, real 5,300-year-old man — not a replica — stares back at you through refrigerated glass. The most remarkable preserved human body in the world, with more scientific secrets still being decoded.

entities.summary: The smallest walled town in the Alps (882 inhabitants), at 907 m in the Vinschgau. Perfectly intact 16th-century curtain walls with three gated towers, a medieval arcaded main street, and a Romanesque church. A true time-capsule town.

compactRecord.n: Juval Castle (Castel Juval) — Messner Mountain Museum
compactRecord.rs: The most atmospheric of Messner's six museums. The remote approach on foot through chestnut woods, the medieval tower, and Tibetan thangkas inside create a deeply memorable visit.
compactRecord.td: 13th-century castle at c. 1,000 m at the entrance of the Schnalstal (Vinschgau), former summer home of Reinhold Messner until 2025. MMM Juval focuses on 'magic mountains' — Tibetan art, masks from five continents. Accessible only on foot (1 h) or shuttle.

compactRecord.n: Marienberg Abbey (Abtei Marienberg / Abbazia Monte Maria)
compactRecord.rs: Europe's highest Benedictine abbey crowns a spur above the Vinschgau with the Ortler glacier glinting to the south. The crypt frescoes — barely known outside specialist circles — are among the Alps' finest Romanesque paintings.

compactRecord.n: Stelvio National Park (Nationalpark Stilfserjoch) — Alto Adige Sector
